text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Aah, jeez! Where is everyone~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the hallway, I spotted Bamboo Memory 
holding her head in her hands, a rare 
sight for her.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... today's our regular 
Disciplinary Committee meeting, but not a 
single member has shown up! And we have so 
many important agenda items lately...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Like "The Issue of Bringing Too Many 
Personal Items onto Campus"! Or stepping 
up the "No Napping Even After Morning 
Practice Campaign"...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Like, whether we should start practicing 
Crow Language to lecture the crows ruining 
our crops...! At this rate, we won't get 
any real talking done, ss-su~!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
C-Class Rep! I found where the members 
are! T-This way...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So this is where everyone was, 'ssu! Come 
on, let's start the regular meeting—

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text:
"...No no no! I'm not going! I worked hard 
enough today! I'm resting for the rest of 
the day!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? What are you saying! I mean, 
what's with that childish--

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text:
Mommy~! We did our best, right? Can we 
take a break now~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yeeees♪ Of course, everyone has been so, 
so good♪ Please take all the time you need 
to rest up~♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
C-Creek-senpai...!? What on earth are you 
doing here~?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? We were just~—

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
Alright, finished patrolling the school 
grounds! ...Phew~ I'm beat~...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My♪ You've been working so hard, what a 
good job you're doing~♪ Why not take a 
little break? There's delicious tea and 
snacks, too~♪

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member C
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, heeeey... phew. ...Where did she 
go? Her patrol should've been done by 
now...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my♪ Coming to look for your friend— 
what a good little one you are~♪ A great 
kid like you deserves a tasty treat♪

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's eat cookies together~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
—While we were doing that, everyone 
gathered here... and we were just having a 
nice, relaxing time together, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... I had no idea everyone was 
that exhausted...! I didn't notice at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Kh... I'm sorry, everyone! I'll take full 
responsibility... and awaken the spirit of 
discipline in all of you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Repeat after me!! "The Morals Committee's 
Five Demon Precepts"!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...One! A lapse in morals is a lapse in 
spirit! One! Passionate discipline must 
come with love! One! Breaking the rules 
shall never be forgiven!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Rule one! Dreams shall not be censored! 
Rule one! Problem children must be dealt 
with 24/7, year-round! ...Rule one! 
Disruptions of public morals shall—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Again and again... until her voice grew 
hoarse, Bamboo Memory kept reciting the 
disciplinary code with all her might. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
...A l-lapse in discipline is a... lapse 
in one's heart...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
! Exactly! A wholesome school life is 
supported by our hands! Now, time to 
remember everything!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Members
text_block_list.text:
"...P-Passionate instruction must be done 
with... love! One, rule breaking shall 
never be tolerated...! One! The desire to 
dream shall never be censored!"

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp?! C-Class Rep?! W-What on earth 
was I...?!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...! Thank goodness...! You've 
remembered the spirit of discipline, 
haven't you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"—Thanks a million for earlier, 
Creek-senpai! Thank you for taking care of 
my committee members! In so many ways!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, done already? What a pity... 
and here I'd even prepared a futon for a 
little nap, too...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm shocked that I failed to notice 
how everyone was doing... As class 
representative, I can't let myself stay 
like this!

I want to cherish the power of unity even 
more.

I want to cherish the power of our unity 
even more.

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, Class Rep! Let's get back 
to basics, and do our usual routine 
together!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Are we doing that, su?! All Morals 
Committee members, Formation A!!"

text_block_list.name: The Disciplinary Committee
text_block_list.text:
"...It is finished!! The 'Disciplinary 
Committee Spirit Injection Pose'!!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! Everyone looks so neat and 
lovely together~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, the Disciplinary Committee 
had a heart-to-heart, and it seemed they 
succeeded in deepening their bond even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you're right! Thanks to Creek-senpai, 
everyone looks so refreshed, ssul

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Creek-senpai! I have a favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"To learn how you do things, Senpai... 
could we hold a 'Pampering Club' for a 
while, please?!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My! Is that all right!? Of course, I would 
love to~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I'm a bit uneasy, but with this, will 
the problems the Disciplinary Committee 
held head towards a resolution... I 
wonder?
